escena: SCENE (print review, post-production studio in Santiago, late afternoon): a single hard shaft of low sun cuts through half-open venetian blinds and lands directly ON THE MAN, raking across his shoulder and the side of his face while fine dust drifts inside the beam; he stands leaning over a lit lightbox table, holding a loupe down onto a strip of printed proofs for a specialty coffee brand's key visual, and he is lifting the loupe away mid-gesture at the exact moment he finds the flaw, his free hand holding an orange grease pencil. He looks down at the proofs, never at the camera. Behind him, well out of focus, a calibration monitor glows cool azure blue across the far wall of the room. 85mm lens at f/1.8, focus on his hands and the loupe. Everything is unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of a dark walnut equipment cabinet standing between the camera and the table
